package rulefixtures

	"net/http"
	_ "net/http/pprof"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_profiling_benchmarking_pprof_endpoint_enabled_without_sampling_plan: Layer: Profiling and benchmarking. Flag always-on profiling endpoints in production services without access or sampling controls.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func StartServer(addr string) error {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	})
	return http.ListenAndServe(addr, mux)
}
